summary: Completed Interlude 01 (The Therac-25): Reflected on human-automation trust boundaries, automation complacency, and non-negotiable engineering interlocks in AI workflows.
evidence: Reflection 1 (The False 'Ready' Indicator): A green test suite is not proof of safety; tests often only verify happy paths while masking unverified security boundaries, race conditions, and unhandled edge cases.

Reflection 2 (Preserving Workflow Interlocks): Identified essential interlocks (independent line-by-line human review, out-of-band CLI verification, and CI SAST checks); removing them due to automation complacency guarantees that subtle hallucinations reach production.
